scope: resident Rust repository search after a source-content edit; same checkout, same contained query, same max-files limit

change.prior_path: any freshness change rebuilt both the file search index and path index
change.candidate_path: content-only edits rebuild the search index while retaining the immutable path index; directory/layout edits still rebuild both
change.invalidation: generation and candidate cache are updated atomically; path_generation remains stable for content-only edits

protocol.query: needle timing_unit; scope hcli/; glob *.py; max_results 20; max_per_file 3

summary.interpretation: small but repeatable content-refresh reduction under this filesystem protocol; not a general filesystem or model-TPS claim

verification.sovereign_tree: existing hawkingd root and descendants untouched

claim_boundary: This receipt covers a native repository lifecycle reduction only. It does not claim model speed, end-to-end HCLI TPS, capability, ANE execution, or Odyssey readiness.
